after.zh: 平均一次是方的，平均三次几乎就是高斯了。平滑叠平滑会越来越像高斯，所以高斯在视觉里无处不在。
after.en: Averaging once gives a square; averaging three times is almost a Gaussian. Smoothing on top of smoothing looks more and more like a Gaussian, which is why Gaussians are everywhere in vision.

t.zh: 方块模糊有个毛病：它把一个亮点摊成一块平顶的方墩，有硬边，也有角。镜头失焦拍出的光点却是圆的，从中心往外慢慢变淡。
t.en: Box blur has a flaw: it spreads a bright dot into a flat-topped square block, with hard edges and corners. But a point of light shot through an out-of-focus lens is round, fading gradually outwards from the centre.

caption.zh: 3×3 平均处理一个亮点，用地形画法看
caption.en: A 3×3 average applied to a bright dot, in terrain view

t.zh: 这种柔和的模糊叫<part-ref to="gauss"></part-ref>：中心权重最大，越远越小，切开看像一口钟。σ 越大，钟越宽，图越糊。修图软件里最常用的模糊就是它。
t.en: This soft blur is called a <part-ref to="gauss"></part-ref>: the weight is largest at the centre and smaller further out, and a slice through it looks like a bell. The larger σ, the wider the bell and the blurrier the image. It is the blur photo editors use most.

t.zh: 新画法「地形」：把亮度当成高度，亮的地方是山，暗的地方是谷。
t.en: A new way of drawing, "Terrain": brightness becomes height, so bright places are hills and dark places are valleys.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：手里没有高斯，只有 3×3 平均，却要做出和目标几乎一样的结果。用地形画法看，亮点的期望是一座圆滑的小山。
t.en: Your task in this level: you have no Gaussian, only the 3×3 average, yet you must produce almost exactly the target result. In terrain view, the expected output for a bright dot is a smooth little hill.

brief.zh: 做出和目标一样的柔和模糊（σ ≈ 1.4 的高斯）。手里只有 3×3 平均。
brief.en: Make the same soft blur as the target (a Gaussian with σ ≈ 1.4). All you have is the 3×3 average.

hint.zh: 一次平均太“方”。多来几次会怎样？
hint.en: One average is too "square". What happens if you do it a few more times?
